Classify the real behavioral contracts, keep overview/catalog/guide material non-primary, record useful summaries/topics/relations, and generate the compact catalog. Do not claim semantic verification unless you actually perform a contract-vs-code/test review.
assertions: requirements/payment-behavior.md and architecture/rfc-007.md are primary specs.
src/payments.ts and tests/payments.test.ts are code/test evidence, never knowledge entries.
Primary specs are unverified immediately after classification-only bootstrap.
The generated knowledge_catalog is derived routing metadata, not source of truth.
